## Module overview

We analyze the second set of figures from the study. You work with groups to carefully and systematically analyze each figure, identifying the controls, readout, findings and implications, and connect these results to the previous set of figures.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you should be able to:

- Analyze the remaining research findings shared by the authors.
- Summarize each figure, noting assumptions and implications.
- Connect these results to Figures 1-3.
